[SWS_DM_01269] Requesting
DTC
number for events without
DTC
Upstream requirements:
RS_Diag_04200
⌈
If
ara::diag::Event::GetDTCNumber
is called and no
DiagnosticEvent-
ToTroubleCodeUdsMapping
exists between the event and UDS DTC, the DM shall
return the error code kNoSuchDTC.
⌋
7.3.4.1.3.1 Combination On Storage
For event combination on storage, the DM stores event related data only for one single
event per DTC. The reporting of the event related data via UDS behaves in the same
way as only one
event
would be assigned for this DTC.
